about: Rated rows a state's LaxNumbers feed tags with ANOTHER state, ruled to be rostered in the FEED's state as league members. The game import (src/laxnumbers-games/resolve.js) attaches such a row through the feed's state ONLY if it is listed here with the matching team; any other foreign row that matches only through the feed's state is refused and logged to unresolved_aliases.
ruling: Rostered in the feed's state: these schools are members of that state's league structure and stay that state's teams.
note: Seed data for a future league field. When teams carry a league/membership separate from their geographic state, this file becomes that field's first rows and the state tags here can be corrected without moving any team out of its league.

rows.name: Hermiston
rows.why: Ruled earlier (importer header): an Oregon town in WHSBLA, rostered hermiston_wa. League membership beats geography.
